name: Chicken Fajita Mac and Cheese
assumptions: Yield estimated from total dry pasta (500g) plus other substantial ingredients yielding ~4 adult dinner portions
Total time combines ~5 min prep (chopping/dicing) + ~10 min frying/colouring + 20 min low cook per instructions; no separate roasting time quantified for peppers so not added
Macaroni classified as containing wheat (standard durum wheat pasta)
Heavy cream and cheddar classified as containing milk
Chicken stock and chicken breast confirm non-vegetarian/vegan
Fajita seasoning packet treated as containing wheat starch (conservative default for commercial mixes)
No explicit egg, fish, shellfish, nuts, peanuts, soy or sesame in listed ingredients
Parsley treated as garnish with negligible impact on classifications
instructions:
Fry your onion, peppers and garlic in olive oil until nicely translucent. Make a well in your veg and add your chicken. Add your seasoning and salt. Allow to colour slightly.
Add your cream, stock and macaroni.
Cook on low for 20 minutes. Add your cheeses, stir to combine.
Top with roasted peppers and parsley.

ingredients.name: macaroni
ingredients.assumptions: Dry elbow macaroni, uncooked as added directly to pan per instructions

ingredients.name: chicken stock
ingredients.assumptions: Standard chicken broth/stock; 2 US cups = 480 ml, density ~1 g/ml

ingredients.name: heavy cream
ingredients.assumptions: Heavy cream (whipping cream); 1/2 US cup = 120 ml, density ~1 g/ml

ingredients.name: fajita seasoning
ingredients.assumptions: Typical commercial fajita seasoning packet ~28-35g; assumed 30g total, mostly spices with some starch

ingredients.name: chicken breast
ingredients.assumptions: Raw boneless skinless chicken breast, diced; '3 diced' assumed 3 medium breasts totaling 450g edible portion

ingredients.name: onion
ingredients.assumptions: Small onion, finely diced; typical small onion ~70g edible after peeling

ingredients.name: red pepper
ingredients.assumptions: 2 medium red bell peppers, finely diced; ~120g each edible after deseeding

ingredients.name: garlic
ingredients.assumptions: 2 cloves garlic, minced; typical clove ~3g each, total 6g

ingredients.name: parsley
ingredients.assumptions: Fresh parsley for garnish; 'garnish chopped' assumed 10g typical sprinkled amount for whole recipe
